description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in their mana cost.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
